summary: Frontend regression test for iteration 2 (visual/UX bug fixes: modal opacity, header solidity, footer restructure, ken-burns removal, Emergent badge removal, editorial redesign of Menu/Epicerie/Landing). All 14 requested checks PASS. Primary bug (text bleed-through inside OrderModePicker modal) is fully resolved — modal is now cream #FDFBF7 opaque with dark blurred overlay behind. Product modal and Checkout modal are also fully opaque. Closed banner appears as small inline chip inside hero (not full-width dark bar). Header is always solid cream with backdrop-blur (no transparent state). Footer confirmed 3 columns (Brand / Contact / Naviguer), no 'Horaires' block. index.html contains no 'Made with Emergent', no emergent.sh, no emergent-main.js. Landing hero image is static (no ken-burns). Owner login shows 8 tabs including 'Emails clients'; Staff shows 7 tabs without it. /commander uses terracotta accent + 'Menu' bg text; /epicerie uses sage/brand accent + 'Bottega' bg text.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu.jsx is ~360 lines and mixes ProductModal + Menu component + open-hours logic — consider extracting ProductModal and isOpenNow into their own files as this page grows.

Dialog overlay uses computed rgba(0,0,0,0) in DevTools because Tailwind arbitrary color bg-[#1A1C18]/92 compiles into a CSS var. Visual rendering is correct (verified by screenshots — the modal region is clearly darkened + blurred), so this is only a cosmetic note on how computed styles read.

OrderModePicker uses !bg-[#FDFBF7] with !important override — works, but a cleaner solution would be to update the shared DialogContent base to use a solid token like bg-cream instead of relying on !important overrides at each call site. The change was applied consistently and is not blocking.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Verified by screenshot analysis: mode picker sits fully opaque cream on top of blurred/darkened underlying page — no product names, category rail, or 'Ouvre à HH:MM' text visible within the modal box coordinates.
